ex-oh-susanna.title: Oh! Susanna
ex-oh-susanna.body:
[Verse 1]
I [G]come from Alabama with my banjo on my [D]knee
I'm [G]going to Louisiana, my true love [D]for to [G]see
It [G]rained all night the day I left, the weather it was [D]dry
The [G]sun so hot I froze to death, Susanna, [D]don't you [G]cry

{start_of_chorus: Chorus}
[C]Oh! Susanna, oh [G]don't you cry for [D]me
I've [G]come from Alabama with my banjo [D]on my [G]knee
{end_of_chorus}
